Under it one line: Holographic LED fan with custom 3D content, from $250. Bottom-right a cyan button Request a quote and a plain link See it in the wild. Under the fan a calm specs strip: Ø 42 cm, 1024 × 800 px, 224 LEDs, 150° viewing, 20 W. At the very bottom edge the next section begins: How it works, with the start of a diagram of the blade sweeping the picture into place.

Not a poster: a working web page with legible links, text and buttons.
